batch_node.name: Samsite Compliance collector schedule v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Seeds a Schedule that fires the Samsite Compliance collector once per day at 00:00 UTC. Paired with the AWS Core schedule (12:00 UTC) — compliance synthesis runs midnight so it processes the AWS resource state collected at noon. The SCHEDULED_TARGET edge points at the Samsite Compliance collector entity, whose entity_id is the UUIDv5 derived from its registry scope:key per req-tap-cares-collector-model-10.

node.name: Samsite Compliance collector — midnight
node.description: Runs the Samsite Compliance collector once per day at 00:00 UTC to fetch KSI signal, VDR report, OSCAL SSP/POA&M, and IIW renderings and decompose them into KSI / VDR / compliance_artifact nodes on the graph.

entity.name: Samsite Compliance midnight schedule SCHEDULED_TARGET samsite-compliance collector
